name: cbctscope
description: Navigation-only AI-agent control of the CBCTScope CBCT viewer running on this machine. Research use only; not a medical device.
long_description: CBCTScope is a local-first CBCT and 2D radiograph viewer. This bundle connects Claude Desktop to a viewer already running on this computer: the agent can open a scan (or let you pick one, without ever seeing the path), switch reading modes, set the window, step through slices, walk the panoramic arch, bookmark and restore saved views, and take snapshots to look at. No tool returns findings or diagnoses, no tool executes code, and nothing leaves the machine. Start the viewer first: https://github.com/rezamotaghi/cbctscope

tools.name: open_scan
tools.description: Point the viewer at a local CBCT export by path; returns the volume catalog.

tools.name: pick_scan
tools.description: Open the native file dialog so the human picks a scan; returns the label and catalog, never the path.

tools.name: list_volumes
tools.description: List every volume the viewer can display, with technical geometry.

tools.name: select_volume
tools.description: Display the volume with the given id.

tools.name: viewer_state
tools.description: Read what is on screen: volume, mode, window, slice positions, 3D style, saved views.

tools.name: set_view_mode
tools.description: Switch the reading mode (mpr, grid, pano, tmj, reslice, ceph, region, stitch).

tools.name: set_window_level
tools.description: Set the display window by preset or center/width, optionally inverted.

tools.name: navigate_slice
tools.description: Move to a slice in the pane's own count (MPR panes, the grid window, the pano axial editor).

tools.name: navigate_arch
tools.description: Pano: center the cross-sections at a position along the drawn arch, in mm.

tools.name: list_views
tools.description: List the saved views of the selected volume and who saved each.

tools.name: goto_view
tools.description: Restore a saved view by id or name.

tools.name: save_view
tools.description: Bookmark the current presentation under a name, marked as agent-saved.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Capture the visible panes as a PNG with a one-line state caption.

tools.name: reset_view
tools.description: Reset the cameras to orthogonal; optionally also window, inversion, and gamma.

viewer_url.title: Viewer URL
viewer_url.description: Where the CBCTScope viewer is running (start it with npm run dev or the double-click starter).
